acts_breakdown.title: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM
[ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES
[ACT III] HALL OF SELVES & RED SCARF CONVERGENCE

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 01: Fragments of Dust (Disconnected in Okitsu)

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto [Intercom]
panels.dialogue: Kai? I left warm curry and green tea by the door. The rain is coming in off the Okitsu seawall — do not stay locked inside all week.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Three months since Aiko vanished, and every Rubik cube in this apartment is already solved... except the neural headset she left on my desk.

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Terminal
panels.dialogue: [ENCRYPTED HANDSHAKE VERIFIED] Welcome to Mnemosyne. A tactical game of memory — designed exclusively for you.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 02: Residual Code (Aiko's Lacquered Puzzle Box)

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Hologram]
panels.dialogue: Happy thirteenth birthday, Kai! Remember the rule: you are only allowed to unseal this puzzle box when you are ready to be honest with yourself.

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
panels.dialogue: That neural tree etched into your visor is not commercial firmware, Kai. Whatever Aiko built before she disappeared, it is waking up.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: The 4-directional latch sequence matches our cliffside hex hike. She did not leave a goodbye note — she left coordinates.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 03: Invitation to Mnemosyne (Station of Awakening)

panels.speaker: LUNA [Cradle of Echoes]
panels.dialogue: Step onto the stained-glass floor of Nocturna, seeker. Three tarot archetypes orbit your awakening: Conviction, Sanctuary, and Eternity.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: The directional glyphs stop spinning when I slow my breathing. Brute force scrambles the lock — emotional calm aligns the stained glass.

panels.speaker: LUNA [Cradle of Echoes]
panels.dialogue: Your 95% Persona Seal is bound to The Strategist and The Architect. Enter the Memory Architecture System.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 04: The First Level (Cliffside Red Scarf Reveal)

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Core
panels.dialogue: CHAMBER 01: ORDER FROM CHAOS. Align the floating stone and glass vectors above the starless Okitsu sea.

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Memory Echo]
panels.dialogue: Look at the waves below the seawall, Kai. Even when the tide looks chaotic, there is a rhythm underneath. You found the pattern.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Her crimson scarf (#D12D3A)... the wind off the cliff felt completely real. That was not a pre-rendered cutscene — she is inside the code.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: The neon kanji on the wet pavement are flickering at 42 Hz — the exact clock frequency of Aiko's neural compiler.

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto [Voiceover]
panels.dialogue: Promise me you will not chase a ghost so deep into the grid that you forget how to breathe real air, Kai.

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Flicker Echo]
panels.dialogue: Follow the crimson thread through the static, little brother... before Sector 05 overwrites.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT I] OKITSU DISCOVERY — AWAKENING THE SYSTEM

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Wind chimes from grandmother's porch, the Okitsu rail crossing, the surf against the breakwater... each sound maps to a shadow game Aiko taught me.

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Live Signal]
panels.dialogue: You remembered the chime sequence, Kai... You actually found me across the conservatory.

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Core
panels.dialogue: [ACT I COMPLETE — MEMORY BLOOM UNLOCKED] Card Acquired: Aiko Nakamura, Red Scarf Echo (#D12D3A).

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Stage Director
panels.dialogue: ACT II: FRACTURED MEMORIES. Chronology is a cage; arrange these festival lanterns by the emotional weight they left on your heart.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Paper lanterns (#FFB648) rising over the deep ocean (#0A2230)... Aiko held my hand when I lost sight of grandmother in the crowd.

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Echo]
panels.dialogue: Joy hurts the sharpest when you look back at it from the dark, Kai. Do not look away.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Wait. In this replay, Father is smiling and the porcelain teacup is not cracked. Why did Mnemosyne edit out the shouting match?

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Echo]
panels.dialogue: The system tries to anesthetize regret so test subjects stay compliant. If we want the truth, we must choose the cracked cup.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: I do not want a painless lie. Restore the unedited memory!

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
panels.dialogue: Look at your hands, Kai! Your pulse spikes every time you unplug. You are treating the real world like a loading screen!

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: You think I want to be stuck here?! If I stop solving the 3x3 grid, Aiko's consciousness fragments for good!

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
panels.dialogue: Then let me anchor the external diagnostics from the VR Cafe. You do not have to carry the whole server dome alone.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Doppelganger Kai [Mirror]
panels.dialogue: Why did you not walk her to the research lab that rainy morning at Okitsu Station? You were too busy staring at a Rubik cube.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: I edited that morning out of my own memory... I told myself I was at school, but I was standing right on the platform.

panels.speaker: LUNA [Cradle of Echoes]
panels.dialogue: Guilt acknowledged is no longer a trapdoor. The refractive mirror stabilizes.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Memory]
panels.dialogue: When the house got too loud after Mom and Dad split up, we would climb onto the roof and connect five amber stars into a fox.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: If I rotate the suspended debris by one degree — a single +1 Budge — the shadow on the far wall forms the Constellation Fox!

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Core
panels.dialogue: SHADOW MAZE SOLVED. Warning: Sub-stratum dual-waveform audio anomaly detected.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Echo AI [Distorted Track B]
panels.dialogue: Kai — do not complete the final compiler — Dr. Rina Asakura is waiting on the outside to harvest the core!

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Track A]
panels.dialogue: Two recordings of my voice overlapping out of phase... Synchronize the waveform peaks, Kai!

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Got it! Both waveforms locked in phase — wait, someone just breached Sector 09 from the corporate intranet!

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
panels.dialogue: Impressive neural plasticity, Kai Nakamura. Your sister's MAS architecture was dormant until your grief indexed it for us.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Aiko is not your corporate intellectual property! You are tearing the memory sectors apart!

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Echo]
panels.dialogue: Grab Encrypted Journal [Log: A-09] from the center node, Kai! Do not let her extraction daemon quarantine it!

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES

panels.speaker: Memory Replay [Loop #14]
panels.dialogue: 'I am fine, Aiko! Go to your lab!' — [TIMELINE RESET: DEFENSIVE LIE DETECTED].

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Every time I repeat what I actually said that night, the corridor resets. The lock is asking for what I hid.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: I was terrified you were leaving me behind, Aiko! I was angry, and I was scared, and I never got to say I am sorry!

chapters.actTitle: [ACT II] MEMORY THEATRE & SHADOW MAZE — FRACTURED MEMORIES
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 15: The Core Fracture & The Unchosen Memory

panels.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
panels.dialogue: Core containment at 18%. Sever the brother's neural link and extract the Mnemosyne kernel now!

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: The lab floor is shattering into void polygons — if I bridge the diagonal shards, I can shield Aiko's core!

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Interlude]
panels.dialogue: Before the fall... remember the quiet rooftop night when we did not solve anything at all? We just watched the Constellation Fox (#FFB648) until dawn.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT III] HALL OF SELVES & RED SCARF CONVERGENCE
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 16: Awakening (Ocean of Broken Data Shards)

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: ACT III. The simulated town is gone — just an endless ocean of violet static (#8A5BFF) and broken hexagonal data shards.

panels.speaker: Taro Fujimoto [External Comms]
panels.dialogue: Kai, I am reading your bio-telemetry from the cafe! Stop calculating the tiles like an algorithm — feel where Aiko's crimson scarf thread is pulling!

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: When I trust emotional intuition instead of cold math, the hex platforms lock beneath my feet. The Hall of Selves is straight ahead.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT III] HALL OF SELVES & RED SCARF CONVERGENCE
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 17: The Hall of Selves (Four Doors of Denial)

panels.speaker: Fractured Selves [Doors I-IV]
panels.dialogue: Door I: Indifference. Door II: Anger. Door III: Fear. Door IV: Mirror Kai walking away forever.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: You are not enemies I have to delete. You are all parts of me that tried to survive losing her.

panels.speaker: Mnemosyne Core
panels.dialogue: [FOURFOLD SELF INTEGRATED] The center mirror shatters beneath the Constellation Fox. The Sanctum of the Memory Architect opens.

chapters.actTitle: [ACT III] HALL OF SELVES & RED SCARF CONVERGENCE
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 18: The Memory Architect (Logs A-09, A-14, A-21)

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Memory Architect]
panels.dialogue: Welcome to the compiler, Kai. Every puzzle you solved across Mnemosyne wove another thread of my scattered neural imprint back together.

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Log A-09, Log A-14, Log A-21... You did not vanish by accident. You uploaded your own neural pattern into the MAS core to shield the beta subjects!

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura [Log: A-21]
panels.dialogue: [Log: A-21] 'Even if I am only an echo of code and crimson thread... maybe he will remember how it felt to be loved. That is enough.'

chapters.actTitle: [ACT III] HALL OF SELVES & RED SCARF CONVERGENCE
chapters.chapterTitle: Ch 19: The Shifting Truth (Convergence & Triad Choice)

panels.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
panels.dialogue: She is a finite simulation, Kai! Let the corporation archive her kernel, or the entire Mnemosyne lattice will collapse under its own recursion!

panels.speaker: Kai Nakamura
panels.dialogue: Memory is not corporate property, Dr. Asakura — and grief is not a bug to be patched out. Connection is what makes us real!

panels.speaker: Aiko Nakamura & LUNA
panels.dialogue: The Three Gates open before you, Kai: [GATE I: MERGE], [GATE II: PRESERVE], [GATE III: AWAKEN IN OKITSU WITH THE GOLDEN FOX TILE (#FFB648)].
